arxiv-1911-10087.title: Mapping Observations of complex organic molecules around Sagittarius B2 with ARO 12m telescope 2019 Mapping Observations of complex organic molecules around Sagittarius B2 with ARO 12m telescope – References
arxiv-1911-10087.creator: Juan Li, Junzhi Wang, Haihua Qiao, Donghui Quan, Min Fang, Fujun Du, Fei Li, Zhiqiang Shen, Shanghuo Li, Di Li, Yong Shi, Zhiyu Zhang, Jiangshui Zhang
arxiv-1911-10087.description: Abstract We performed high-sensitivity mapping observations of several complex organic molecules around Sagittarius B2 with ARO 12m telescope at 3-mm wavelength. Based on their spatial distribution, molecules can be classified as either “extended" that detected not only in Sgr B2(N) and Sgr B2(M), or “compact" that only detected toward or near to Sgr B2(N) and Sgr B2(M).

arxiv-2011-08280.description: Abstract The paper presents a measurement of the Standard Model Higgs Boson decaying to b b -quark pairs in the vector boson fusion (VBF) production mode. A sample corresponding to 126 fb -1 of s = 13 ​ TeV \sqrt{s}=13\,\text{Te\kern-1.

arxiv-2112-09829.title: Multi-Object Grasping – Generating Efficient Robotic Picking and Transferring Policy
arxiv-2112-09829.creator: Adheesh Shenoy, Tianze Chen, Yu Sun
arxiv-2112-09829.description: Abstract Transferring multiple objects between bins is a common task for many applications. In robotics, a standard approach is to pick up one object and transfer it at a time. However, grasping and picking up multiple objects and transferring them together at once is more efficient.

arxiv-2202-05322.title: Homotopy coherent representations
arxiv-2202-05322.creator: Tim Porter, Jim Stasheff
arxiv-2202-05322.description: Abstract . Homotopy coherence has a considerable history, albeit also by other names. For this volume highlighting symmetries, the appropriate use is homotopy coherence of representations , at one time known as representations up to homotopy/homotopy coherent representations. We provide a brief semi-historical survey providing some links that may not be common knowledge. 1.

arxiv-2203-01525.title: Assessment of Dark Matter Models Using Dark Matter Correlations across Dwarf Spheroidal Galaxies
arxiv-2203-01525.creator: Ahmad Borzou
arxiv-2203-01525.description: Abstract The predicted size of dark matter substructures in kilo-parsec scales is model-dependent. Therefore, if the correlations between dark matter mass densities as a function of the distances between them are measured via observations, we can scrutinize dark matter scenarios. In this paper, we present an assessment procedure of dark matter scenarios.

arxiv-2307-00916.title: Enhanced Spectral Density of a Single Germanium Vacancy Center in a Nanodiamond by Cavity-Integration
arxiv-2307-00916.creator: Florian Feuchtmayr, Robert Berghaus, Selene Sachero, Gregor Bayer, Niklas Lettner, Richard Waltrich, Patrick Maier, Viatcheslav Agafonov, Alexander Kubanek
arxiv-2307-00916.description: Abstract Color centers in diamond, among them the negatively-charged germanium vacancy (GeV - ), are promising candidates for many applications of quantum optics such as a quantum network. For efficient implementation, the optical transitions need to be coupled to a single optical mode.

arxiv-2401-03686.title: Inverse Design of Frequency Selective Surface Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
arxiv-2401-03686.creator: Ren Wang
arxiv-2401-03686.description: Abstract This paper uses Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) to design Frequency Selective Surface (FSS). PINN integrates physical information into the loss function, so training PINN does not require a dataset, which will be faster than traditional neural networks for inverse design.

arxiv-2406-04046.title: ActionReasoningBench: Reasoning about Actions with and without Ramification Constraints
arxiv-2406-04046.creator: Divij Handa, Pavel Dolin, Shrinidhi Kumbhar, Tran Cao Son, Chitta Baral
arxiv-2406-04046.description: Abstract Reasoning about Actions and Change (RAC) has historically played a pivotal role in solving foundational AI problems, such as the frame problem. It has driven advancements in AI fields, such as non-monotonic and commonsense reasoning. RAC remains crucial for AI systems that operate in dynamic environments, engage in interactive scenarios, or rely on commonsense reasoning.

arxiv-2411-01401.title: Pre-trained Molecular Language Models with Random Functional Group Masking Corresponding to Haoyi Xiong via haoyi.xiong.fr@ieee.org
arxiv-2411-01401.creator: Tianhao Peng, Yuchen Li, Xuhong Li, Jiang Bian, Zeke Xie, Ning Sui, Shahid Mumtaz, Yanwu Xu, Linghe Kong, Haoyi Xiong
arxiv-2411-01401.description: Abstract Recent advancements in computational chemistry have leveraged the power of trans-former-based language models, such as MoLFormer, pre-trained using a vast amount of simplified molecular-input line-entry system (SMILES) sequences, to understand and predict molecular properties and activities, a critical step in fields like drug discovery and materials science.

arxiv-2509-03566.title: Volume comparison on finite-volume hyperbolic 3-manifolds
arxiv-2509-03566.creator: Ruojing Jiang, Franco Vargas Pallete
arxiv-2509-03566.description: Abstract . On finite-volume hyperbolic 3 3 -manifolds, we compare volumes of different metrics using the exponential convergence of Ricci-DeTurck flow toward the hyperbolic metric h 0 h_{0} . We prove that among metrics with scalar curvature bounded below by − 6 -6 , h 0 h_{0} minimizes the volume.

arxiv-2510-26774.title: Compact Accretion Disks in the Aftermath of Tidal Disruption Events: Parameter Inference from Joint X-ray Spectra and UV/Optical Photometry Fitting
arxiv-2510-26774.creator: M. Guolo, A. Mummery, S. van Velzen, S. Gezari, M. Nicholl, Y. Yao, M. Karmen, Y. Ajay, T. Wevers, N. LeBaron, R. Chornock
arxiv-2510-26774.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by M. Guolo, A. Mummery, S. van Velzen, S. Gezari, M. Nicholl, Y. Yao, M. Karmen, Y. Ajay, T. Wevers, N. LeBaron, R. Chornock. We present a multi-wavelength analysis of 14 tidal disruption events (TDEs)—including an off-nuclear event associated with an ultra-compact dwarf galaxy—selected for having available thermal X-ray spectra during their late-time UV/optical plateau phase.

pmc-10480101.title: Reconstruction of cervico-thoracic defect with bipedicled deep inferior epigastric perforator free flap following resection of a giant recurrent thyroid tumor: a case report and review of literature
pmc-10480101.creator: Abraham Zavala, María I Vargas, Walter Ayala, Antonio Muñoz, Miguel A Chávez, Jesús López, Ricardo Delgado
pmc-10480101.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The bipedicled Deep Inferior Epigastric Perforator (DIEP) flap, originally described and primarily utilized in autologous breast reconstruction for specific cases, has expanded its applications to encompass diverse anatomical regions in recent years. This report presents the case of a 69-year-old woman with a recurrent giant thyroid tumor who underwent surgical resection, resulting in a large cervico-thoracic defect effectively reconstructed using a bipedicled DIEP flap.

pmc-10481609.title: Addressing non-response data for standardized post-acute functional items
pmc-10481609.creator: Chih -Ying Li, Hyunkyoung Kim, Brian Downer, Mi Jung Lee, Kenneth Ottenbacher, Yong-Fang Kuo
pmc-10481609.description: BackgroundThe post-acute patient standardized functional items (Section GG) include non-response options such as refuse, not attempt and not applicable. We examined non-response patterns and compared four methods to address non-response functional data in Section GG at nation-wide inpatient rehabilitation facilities (IRF).MethodsWe characterized non-response patterns using 100% Medicare 2018 data.

pmc-10675635.title: Automated Cow Body Condition Scoring Using Multiple 3D Cameras and Convolutional Neural Networks
pmc-10675635.creator: Gary I Summerfield, Allan De Freitas, Este van Marle-Koster, Herman C Myburgh, Krista Zalik, Štefan Kohek
pmc-10675635.description: Body condition scoring is an objective scoring method used to evaluate the health of a cow by determining the amount of subcutaneous fat in a cow. Automated body condition scoring is becoming vital to large commercial dairy farms as it helps farmers score their cows more often and more consistently compared to manual scoring.

pmc-11538346.title: Fast and light-efficient remote focusing for volumetric voltage imaging
pmc-11538346.creator: Urs L. Böhm, Benjamin Judkewitz
pmc-11538346.description: Voltage imaging holds great potential for biomedical research by enabling noninvasive recording of the electrical activity of excitable cells such as neurons or cardiomyocytes. Camera-based detection can record from hundreds of cells in parallel, but imaging entire volumes is limited by the need to focus through the sample at high speeds.

pmc-12358617.title: A study on the growth and physiological traits of Leymus chinensis in artificial grasslands under exogenous hormone regulation
pmc-12358617.creator: Jifu Chen, Qiang Chen, Xiangyang Hou
pmc-12358617.description: Leymus chinensis is a dominant perennial grass species in the Eurasian steppe, valued for its ecological and economic importance. Conducting research on the formation mechanism and regulatory approaches of artificial grassland productivity is the great significance for improving grassland productivity, and restoration and reconstruction of degraded grassland.

pmc-12525075.title: Serial Combination of Toxic and Ischemic Renal Damages Causes Subsequent Chronic, Irreversible, and Progressive Renal Disease in Rats
pmc-12525075.creator: Giampiero A Massaro, Joana Mercado-Hernández, Roel Broekhuizen, Tri Q Nguyen, Isabel Fuentes-Calvo, Sandra M Sancho-Martínez, Carlos Martínez-Salgado, Francisco J López-Hernández, Eric Huet
pmc-12525075.description: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) poses a global burden affecting over 10% of the adult population worldwide. Acute kidney injury (AKI) is an important cause of CKD, especially following severe and repeated episodes. However, the processes underpinning progressive and chronic renal deterioration after AKI are only incompletely understood.

pmc-12564421.title: Clinical Impact of FDG PET/CT in Pulmonary Nodule Characterization: Current Perspectives on Dual-Time-Point Imaging and Semi-Quantitative Imaging Metrics
pmc-12564421.creator: Nikolaos Kapsoritakis, Foteini Tsitoura, Maria Stathaki, Olga Bourogianni, Panagiotis Georgoulias, Georgios D. Barmparis, Antonios Bertsias, Giorgos P. Tsironis, Sophia Koukouraki
pmc-12564421.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryPulmonary nodules are frequently detected via conventional imaging, and distinguishing benign from malignant lesions remains a diagnostic challenge. 18F-FDG PET/CT has become a key imaging modality for evaluating these nodules based on their metabolic activity.

pmc-13543355.title: Improved laser capture microdissection combined with transcriptome sequencing reveals gene expression reprogramming during rice panicle branch meristems differentiation
pmc-13543355.creator: Gui Yan, Tao Song, Lei Xu, Jinbo Li, Binliang Wan, Lei Zhou, Haidan Wu, Yachun Zhang, Jiaojiao Zhao, Liqi Tong, Liushang He, Zhaojian Song, Xianhua Zhang, Wei Wang, Detian Cai, Yuchi He
pmc-13543355.description: BackgroundThe number of branches per panicle exhibits a strong positive correlation with the grain number per panicle, which is a key agronomic trait determining rice yield. Efficient and precise identification of genes regulating the development of panicle branch meristems will contribute to high-yield rice breeding.

uslaw-usc-t42-s3057f.title: 42 U.S.C. § 3057f — Surplus educational facilities
uslaw-usc-t42-s3057f.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s3057f.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 35 (Programs For Older Americans); Subchapter X (Grants For Native Americans); Part A (Indian Program). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Multipurpose senior centers Notwithstanding any other provision of law, the Secretary of the Interior through the Bureau of Indian Affairs shall make available surplus Indian educational facilities to tribal organizations.
